start.text: You rub a hand's width of soot off the inside of a pane. It comes away like velvet, and under it the glass is good.

The Lanternreach, all of it, from higher than anybody but a High Keeper ever saw it: grey to the edge of the world, and set round the rim of it, the six lights you lit. From up here you can see they make a ring, and that the ring has nothing in the middle.
Saltmarrow's, on the Gull, the first. The lullaby in Pell's pebble went into that one.
Saltmarrow's, on the Gull, the first. Saltmarrow's founding knot went into that one.
Saltmarrow's, on the Gull, the first. What Mara remembered of her brother went into that one, with the whittled gull.
Lowsong's, last, low on the water in the south, where the singing used to come from.
Behind you, the room is singing to the backs of your shoulders. Nobody up here ever looked out, you think. They looked in, at the fire.
